exact_statement: For every fixed finite original forests.tex reference with positive feasible lambda, every nonempty covered A and eligible ownership assignment tau, let V be the used gates, s_u=|A_u|, g=|V|, a=|A|, e=g minus the number of original source SCCs, D=product_all(1+lambda_l*pi_l)-1, and t_u the original size/subset probability. Let T_tau be the incoming-Laplacian forest polynomial weighted by root pi over exactly one root per original source SCC. Define N_s(x^h)=product_u[product_(j in A_u)h_j!/((c_u+1)(c_u+2)*binom(s_u+c_u-1,c_u))], c_u=sum_(j in A_u)h_j. The exact conditioned mass of all distinct actual partition-forest events with this assignment and root restriction is Q_tau=product_used(lambda_u*t_u)*N_s(T_tau)/D. Assignments are disjoint, so Q_part=sum_tau Q_tau<=Q_* is a nonempty output subprobability. For independent per-gate triples B with density 2(1-b), rate-one exponential Y, and uniform simplex Z, N_s(T)=2^(-g)E T(BYZ). With factorial surrogate operator M, 2^(-(a+g+e))*3^(-e)*M(T)<=N_s(T)<=2^(-g)*M(T). Forced e-child sunflower prime assignments have T=pi*x^e and N_s(T)=pi*e!/((e+1)(e+2)*2^e), explicitly separating surrogate credit from complete queue probability. All label, root, subset, size, attachment, child-count and final-output ambiguity factors are retained; no universal O(I) or FEI bound is asserted.

strictly positive feasible lambda and pi=min(P(h_l=1),1/2)>0
covered nonempty A; owned subsets nonempty and partition A; each used gate visited once
exactly one initial root per original source SCC and no additional roots; deterministic original root and attachment occurrence order
distinct actual child-label sequences are counted, failed/infinite events contribute no output mass
rational polynomial assertion only when pi rational; original subset factors may be algebraic and are kept explicit
ideal complete output reference cost; optional physical prefix rounding is not paid by I

exact_statement: For every finite nonempty simple graph G on its covered coordinates, f_G the positive edge-conjunction union, both fixed endpoint orders per width-two prime gate, pi_e=1/4 and any globally fixed strictly positive feasible lambda_e, put D=product_e(1+lambda_e/4)-1 and r_u=sum_{v neighbor u}lambda_uv. For every covered nonempty A and every inclusion-maximal matching M in G[A], let U=A\V(M). For each choice of a neighbor nu(u) for all u in U, use matching edge gates owning their endpoint pairs, singleton gates {u,nu(u)} owning u as a child at nu(u) if matched or an isolated root otherwise. Let b count outside-A choices and h_v,h_w count child attachments at endpoints of matching edge e={v,w}, c_e=h_v+h_w. These form distinct actual source-SCC partition queue events. Their exact complete conditioned output mass Q_M(A) equals D^-1 product_{e in M}(lambda_e/24) times sum_nu[product_{u in U}(lambda_{u,nu(u)}/8)*4^(-b)*product_{e={v,w} in M} h_v!h_w!/((c_e+1)^2*(c_e+2))]. Different M and neighbor/chronological choices are disjoint actual events. Q_MS=sum_maximal_M Q_M is positive for every covered nonempty A and is an output subprobability <=Q_part<=Q_*. Each Q_M is at least D^-1*48^(-(|M|+|U|))*product_{e in M}lambda_e*product_{u in U}r_u. Normalized posterior q(r)/Q_MS retains final-output witness entropy. Exact rational log intervals certify C_MS=sum_nonempty P_f(A)log2(1/Q_MS(A))<5I(f_G) for all 63 nonempty labelled graph tables on four variables at each of lambda_e=1/maximum_degree and lambda_uv=1/(degree(u)+degree(v)). The mass and lower bound cover every finite graph and feasible weight vector, but no dimension-independent influence payment is claimed.

exact_statement: For every finite nonempty simple graph G with globally fixed both endpoint orders per width-two prime gate, pi=1/4, strictly positive feasible lambda, and D=product_e(1+lambda_e/4)-1, for every covered nonempty A and inclusion-maximal matching M of G[A], set U=A minus its matched vertices and m=|M|. Put P_M(z)=product_(u in U)[sum_(v outside A,uv edge)lambda_uv/32+sum_(v matched,uv edge)lambda_uv*z_v/8]. For monomial z^h define J_M(z^h)=product_(e={v,w} in M)h_v!h_w!/((c_e+1)^2(c_e+2)), c_e=h_v+h_w. The exact original conditioned maximal-matching star output mass is Q_M=D^-1 product_(e in M)(lambda_e/24) J_M(P_M). With independent per-matching-edge T uniform[0,1], B density 2(1-b), and independent rate-one exponentials Y_v,Y_w, J_M(P)=2^-m E P(X) for X_v=TB*Y_v and X_w=TB*Y_w. For all integers a,b>=0 and c=a+b, a!b!/((c+1)^2(c+2))>=(1/2)*6^-c*2^max(c-1,0). Consequently if P=sum_h p_h z^h, k(h)=sum_e c_e and d(h)=number of matching parents with c_e>0, Q_M>=D^-1 product_(e in M)(lambda_e/48) sum_h p_h*6^-k(h)*2^(k(h)-d(h)). This retains exact occupation multiplicities and a certified collision bonus beyond the discarded-factor row-sum bound, but asserts no universal influence payment or polynomial complexity.
